name: How can I prepare my home for a renovation project?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my home for a renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing your home involves several steps to protect your belongings and ensure a smooth process. Start by decluttering the renovation area, removing all personal items, furniture, and wall hangings. Cover remaining items with tarps or plastic sheeting to protect them from dust and debris. Clear pathways for workers and materials. If pets are in the home, arrange for their care or create a safe, secluded space for them away from the construction zone. Discuss utility access points with your contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your home by decluttering the renovation area, protecting belongings, clearing pathways, and securing pets. Discuss utility access with your contractor.
